transcription.about: Speech to text: transcription, dictation, subtitles, voice typing. Dedicated ASR models and audio-language models both do it, and they are filed under different tasks.
transcription.notes: automatic-speech-recognition holds dedicated ASR (Whisper family, Parakeet, Canary, wav2vec2 fine-tunes). audio-text-to-text holds audio-language models (Voxtral, Qwen-Audio, Granite Speech, Phi multimodal) that transcribe when prompted and can also translate, summarise or follow instructions. any-to-any holds omni models that may take audio in. Check language tags, streaming support, word timestamps, and export formats (CTranslate2, ONNX, sherpa-onnx, GGUF, whisper.cpp) for on-device dictation.

speech-synthesis.about: Text to speech and voice generation.

audio-enhancement.about: Clean, separate or transform audio: denoise, dereverb, source separation, voice conversion.

image-editing.about: Change an existing image with or without a prompt.

document-understanding.about: Read documents, forms, screenshots and scans.

embeddings-and-retrieval.about: Vectors and ranking for search and RAG.

vision-language.about: Models that look at images or video and answer in text.
